It looks like you don't have a remote configured yet. To set up password-less git access, I need to know:

1. **What is the internal remote URL?** (e.g., `git@internal-git:org/repo.git` or `https://git.internal/org/repo.git`)
2. **Which authentication method do you prefer?**
   - **SSH keys** (most secure) — works with `git@host:repo.git` URLs
   - **Git Credential Manager** (Windows native) — stores credentials securely in Windows Credential Manager
   - **Personal access token** (if your internal git supports it) — cached by credential helpers

Once you give me the remote URL, I can set it up and configure the appropriate auth method for your system.
